proof_body:
by
  intro n f L a p hL hp v
  have hv : v = ∑ i, v i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ) := by
    ext j
    simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have hpi : ∀ i, p i = L (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ)) := fun i =>
    (hp i).unique (hL.hasLineDerivAt _)
  calc L v = L (∑ i, v i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ)) := congrArg L hv
    _ = ∑ i, v i * p i := by simp [map_sum, hpi]
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a p : Fin n → ℝ), HasFDerivAt f L a → (∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (a + t • (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin n → ℝ))) (p i) 0) → ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, L v = ∑ i, v i * p i
